notes.title: 0.8.3 - balance changes
notes.notes:
Economy and enemy value / spawn tweaks
 Player spell damage tweaks
 Lowered shotgun shell projectile count by 1 Increased base damage by 3
 Finer sands scales slower and lowered base reduction
 Coins now show on top of bombs
 Attempt at fixing stinger remaining
 Maiden's blood now gives a percentage based bonus
 Boots now trigger faster with movement and are buffed overall


Beta branch

 Fixed an endless crash on hoppper spawn
 Fixed hopper shooting when dead

notes.title: 0.8.0 - Relics, economy changes, and play testing
notes.notes:
Changes to economy
 Larva now appear on top of bullets
 Catmage bullets will now keep moving if it dies during the spreading phase
 Abundant supply now increases shop items by 2 in endless mode
 Capped knockback
 Fixed dedicated journeyman not working in endless
 Changed duration of catsle bullets
 Added pet duck relic
 Slight nerf to nail attack rate while moving
 First shops for each level only carry current shop level items
 Increased random range of multicast
 Fixed bug with container not displaying questionmark in situation where it wasn't doing anything
 Added icon for refundable / repurchaseable items at no extra cost
 Reduced starting backpack slots to 3
 Added curse to increase backpack slots
 Decreased boar speed scaling
 Added loot chests as possible reward drop for elite rooms
 Lowered knockback of explosion, Impact detonator, and bomb
 Removed equip cooldown scaling
 Changed equip cooldowns
 Added Finer Sands
 Fixed duck bonus round ducks appearing too far vertically
 Fixed doors not being in correct position



Playtesting

 Added TH spell
 Added 2 level 4 enemies
